feed_summary: View CSAF Summary Siemens is currently assessing the impact of Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) on Industrial Edge. Please check your Industrial Edge Management (IEM) setup: - No Management Applications installed: No action is required. Although the affected Brotli library is included in the IEM software stack, the affected functionality is not used or exposed. The same applies to IEDK. - Management Applications installed: Follow the specific mitigations until a fix is available. - Device Applications installed: Follow the specific mitigations until a fix is available. For Siemens-managed services, Industrial Edge Hub and Industrial Edge Management Cloud, appropriate Firewall/WAF protection has already been implemented.
